_help: Photos that rotate through the Ministry Highlights slot of the Featured Ministry carousel on the homepage. Admins: upload a JPG/PNG/WEBP into assets/images/ministry-highlights/ via the editor, then add a row here with the filename, an eyebrow, a short title, and an optional body. Each row becomes a candidate slide; the carousel picks 2 per visit, mixed with the curated FALLBACK_SLIDES inside showcase-carousel.js. Empty list = curated slides only.

images.title: Bibles Going Out
images.body: Hundreds of personalized Bibles have made their way into newcomer hands — each with a handwritten note, highlighted verses, and prayer.

images.title: Pack & Ship Nights
images.body: Our volunteers pray over every Bible before it ships. Each package leaves with a blessing, a verse, and the love of our community behind it.

images.title: One Life, One Bible
images.body: A simple hand-off. A personalized Bible. A story that keeps unfolding. This is what Seed the Word is about — one life, one verse, one seed at a time.

images.title: Study Saturday Live
images.body: Every Saturday, 7 PM Pacific, we gather on Twitch for Bible study, prayer, and fellowship with members from around the world.

images.title: Out in the Field
images.body: We don't wait for people to find us — we bring the Gospel into streets, campuses, and coffee shops. Every seed matters.

images.title: Hands That Receive
images.body: Every Bible placed is a prayer answered — a seed sown in soil only the Lord can name.

images.title: Stories Becoming Pages
images.body: Today's hand-off, tomorrow's testimony. The Word keeps walking forward in the lives of the people who receive it.

images.title: Outreach in Action
images.body: Sidewalks, parking lots, the steps of campus libraries — wherever someone is willing to talk, we want to be there with the Word.

images.title: A Body, Not a Crowd
images.body: We greet each other. We share what God has been doing this week. The room becomes a body.

images.title: Walking the Path of Light
images.body: Plant the seed. Water it to grow. Gather the harvest. Every step is the work of the Lord.

images.title: Friends in the Word
images.body: Tuesdays for newcomers. Fridays as young adults. Every gathering is one more chance to come back to the Bible together.

images.title: Reflection Together
images.body: We sit with what we just read. Where did we see grace? What does this say about God? What does it call us to as a body?

images.title: Coming Before Him First
images.body: Singing and prayer gather the room. Before we greet one another, we lift our hearts to Him.

images.title: Lifted Voices
images.body: Prayer and worship are woven into everything we do. Philippians 4:6-8.

images.title: From the Streets to the Word
images.body: Every initiative we run started as someone speaking up at the end of a meeting. Got an idea for who we should reach next?
